question: What term describes a health system made up of multiple distinct operating sectors?
explanation: A pluralistic framework includes diverse organizations and funding structures operating within a single national space. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h1)

question: Why must Nigerian nurses understand the different sectors within the health system?

options.A: To recognize how broader structures impact patient care access
options.B: To manage hospital financial accounts and budgets effectively
options.C: To determine private sector employee salary scales
options.D: To replace the roles of administrative health ministers

explanation: Comprehending sector dynamics helps nurses navigate resource limitations and referral pathways for patients. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h1)

question: Which government tier is primarily responsible for grassroots primary health care centers in Nigeria?
explanation: Local government authorities manage primary health care centers to ensure basic services reach local communities. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h2)

question: What is the main function of federal tertiary medical centers within the public sector?

options.A: Handling specialized referral cases and advanced training
options.B: Regulating private pharmacy drug prices nationwide
options.C: Providing basic immunizations in rural villages
options.D: Collecting local sanitation taxes from market traders

explanation: Federal tertiary institutions serve as referral hubs for complex cases and centers for clinical education. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h2)

question: What is the primary financial mechanism for accessing private for-profit healthcare in Nigeria?
explanation: Most patients pay directly for private services at the point of care without prepayment coverage. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h3)

question: Why do many patients choose private for-profit clinics over public hospitals despite higher costs?

options.A: Government subsidies applied to all private bills
options.B: Guaranteed free medications for chronic diseases
options.C: Shorter wait times and perceived comfort
options.D: Mandatory referral policies from local chiefs

explanation: Private facilities often attract patients through faster service delivery and more comfortable facility environments. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h3)

question: What is the primary driving motive for faith-based health organizations operating in Nigeria?
explanation: Faith-based organizations prioritize community service and health ministry over financial profit generation. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h4)

question: Why are non-profit health organizations particularly successful in rural Nigerian communities?

options.A: They rely exclusively on expensive imported medical equipment
options.B: They enforce mandatory health insurance for all villagers
options.C: They pay higher salaries than federal teaching hospitals
options.D: They build high levels of trust and target underserved areas

explanation: Non-profits often establish roots in remote locations where government infrastructure is absent, earning local trust. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h4)

question: What do Public-Private Partnerships combine to improve health service delivery?

options.A: International NGO grants and local political campaigns
options.B: Public regulatory authority and private efficiency
options.C: Traditional herbal remedies and modern surgery
options.D: Faith-based charity and commercial tax collection

explanation: PPPs merge government oversight and public goals with the capital and management efficiency of private firms. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h5)

question: What is a major advantage of utilizing PPP models for hospital diagnostic services?

options.A: Guaranteeing free diagnostic tests for all citizens
options.B: Transferring all legal liability away from the government
options.C: Eliminating the need for trained laboratory nurses
options.D: Upgrading equipment without full public capital outlay

explanation: Private partners invest capital for modern equipment, sparing the government from bearing the full initial cost. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h5)

question: What economic benefit results from reducing duplication of effort across health sectors?

options.A: Decreased operational wastage and better budget efficiency
options.B: Reduced employment opportunities for nursing graduates
options.C: Increased taxation rates for private clinic owners
options.D: Higher importation costs for essential medicines

explanation: Sharing resources and aligning programs prevents wasted spending on redundant equipment and administrative tasks. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h6)

question: How do coordinated referral networks between sectors protect patients economically?

options.A: By preventing repeated tests and unnecessary out-of-pocket costs
options.B: By offering free transport to private specialist centers
options.C: By waiving all administrative fees at federal hospitals
options.D: By providing automatic health insurance coverage upon admission

explanation: Streamlined referrals stop patients from paying multiple times for duplicate investigations across different facilities. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h6)

question: Which barrier directly prevents seamless patient record sharing between private and public facilities?
explanation: Disjointed record-keeping systems prevent different sectors from sharing patient health data effectively. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h7)

question: Why does cultural friction often occur when public and private sectors attempt to collaborate?

options.A: Equal funding allocations distributed to all participating clinics
options.B: Identical administrative structures used by both organizations
options.C: Mandatory job rotations for nurses between private and public wards
options.D: Conflicting priorities between public welfare and commercial profit

explanation: Public systems focus on population health equity, whereas private entities often prioritize commercial viability and profit. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h7)

question: What key role do clinical nurses frequently play across different healthcare sectors?

options.A: Chief executive officers of private pharmaceutical firms
options.D: Federal ministers of health budget planners

explanation: Nurses coordinate patient care transitions across various public, private, and community health settings. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h8)

question: Why is basic health economics knowledge important for modern nursing practice in Nigeria?

options.A: It helps nurses advocate for efficient resource use and affordable care
options.B: It allows nurses to set private hospital consultation fees
options.C: It exempts nurses from direct patient bedside responsibilities
options.D: It replaces the need for clinical pharmacology training

explanation: Understanding economic principles enables nurses to minimize bedside waste and guide patients toward cost-effective care. [learn more](GST322_U5_T3#GST322_U5_T3_h8)
